description: PAID $0.003 USDC. Canonical Hyperliquid perp book (not HIP-3): mark, oracle, funding, open interest and volume. Research data, not investment advice. For builder DEXes use hl_hip3; for equity perps use stock_perps. Params coin, limit. Covered by pass_day/pass_month. No charge on failure. Returns JSON for canonical Hyperliquid perps: mark, oracle, funding, open interest, and volume.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

coin.description: Optional comma-separated coin filter. Format: Hyperliquid coin symbols. Example: BTC,ETH. Omit for the whole canonical book.

limit.description: Maximum markets, ordered by 24h volume. Format: positive integer. Example: 20. Default: all markets, as the existing tool text states.

name: hl_perps
title: Hyperliquid canonical perp markets ($0.003)
